model.name: BA RFA Flow and Checklist
model.question: What is the end-to-end workflow and validation checklist for executing a Request For Approval under Business Architecture?
model.summary: This model captures the lifecycle of a Business Architecture RFA, detailing actors, review rules, operational controls, and datastores. It establishes the criteria for approval routing and validation gates.

layers.name: Governance and Controls
layers.role: Contains rules, controls, and actors. No apps or technical datastores belong here.

layers.name: Process and Flow
layers.role: Contains processes, channels, and events. No abstract rules belong here.

layers.name: Infrastructure and Data
layers.role: Contains apps, integrations, and datastores. No human governance roles belong here.

nodes.label: Business Architecture Lead
nodes.note: Owns the initial RFA structure and structural validation.

nodes.label: Corporate Governance Standard
nodes.note: Mandatory compliance check required for budget allocation.

nodes.label: RFA Approval Threshold
nodes.note: Decides whether executive sign-off is required based on total cost.

nodes.label: RFA Submission Process
nodes.note: The standardized sequence of gathering requirements and drafting the business case.

nodes.label: Workflow Management App
nodes.note: System of record routing approval requests to designated actors.

nodes.label: RFA Database Archive
nodes.note: Historical record store of past approvals and rejected drafts.

logic.goal: Determine whether an RFA packet satisfies all structural compliance checks before routing to executives.

steps.name: Check Threshold Rules
steps.intent: Verify if cost exceeds rule threshold

steps.name: Final RFA Sign-off
steps.intent: Actor approves or rejects the request
